description: In store.rs unit tests, store_with_alice() and merge tests construct CredentialStore directly via struct literal (CredentialStore { entries, dummy_hash }). This requires that the private fields entries and dummy_hash are accessible within the same module (they are, because tests are in the same file). But it couples the test to the internal representation. A constructor like CredentialStore::new_with_entries_for_test(entries) or reusing from_credentials would be cleaner and more resilient to field renames.
title: auth: CredentialStore entries and dummy_hash fields are pub(crate) in unit tests via struct literal construction
